### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says and `upload_asset` it where you use it — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url upload_asset returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `fonts/<id>` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Nebulica | `fonts/Nebulica-Regular.otf` (weight 400) | `read_file fonts/Nebulica-Regular.otf` | `var(--font-display)` | `nebulica` |
| Elgraine | `fonts/Elgraine-Regular.otf` (weight 400) | `read_file fonts/Elgraine-Regular.otf` | `var(--font-body)` | `elgraine` |

Every face: `fonts/Nebulica-Thin.otf` (Nebulica, 100), `fonts/Nebulica-ExtraLight.otf` (Nebulica, 200), `fonts/Nebulica-Light.otf` (Nebulica, 300), `fonts/Nebulica-Regular.otf` (Nebulica, 400), `fonts/Nebulica-Medium.otf` (Nebulica, 500), `fonts/Nebulica-SemiBold.otf` (Nebulica, 600), `fonts/Nebulica-Bold.otf` (Nebulica, 700), `fonts/Nebulica-ExtraBold.otf` (Nebulica, 800), `fonts/Nebulica-Black.otf` (Nebulica, 900), `fonts/Elgraine-Light.otf` (Elgraine, 300), `fonts/Elgraine-Regular.otf` (Elgraine, 400), `fonts/Elgraine-Italic.otf` (Elgraine, 400, italic), `fonts/Elgraine-Medium.otf` (Elgraine, 500), `fonts/Elgraine-SemiBold.otf` (Elgraine, 600), `fonts/Elgraine-Bold.otf` (Elgraine, 700), `fonts/Elgraine-ExtraBold.otf` (Elgraine, 800), `fonts/Elgraine-Black.otf` (Elgraine, 900), `fonts/Elgraine-BlackItalic.otf` (Elgraine, 900, italic).
